raw_translation: Ka shigar da sashi guda a kowace layi kamar label | lamba na mahaifiyar layin. Ka bar mahaifiyar lamba bacci don tushe guda daidai. Lambobin layin sun danganta ga tsari da aka nuna, suna farawa da ZXQPH0000QXZ.
source: Enter one part per line as label | parent row number. Leave the parent blank for exactly one root. Row numbers refer to the order shown, starting at 1.
translation: Ka shigar da sashi guda a kowace layi kamar label | lamba na mahaifiyar layin. Ka bar mahaifiyar lamba bacci don tushe guda daidai. Lambobin layin sun danganta ga tsari da aka nuna, suna farawa da 1.

source: This is an arithmetic recipe scaler, not a fermentation timer, recipe recommendation, nutrition estimate or food-safety guide. Bread results depend on ingredients, temperature, time and technique that are not included.
translation: Wannan mai auna girke-girke na arithmetic ne, ba mai tsawo na zazzabi, shawara kan girke-girke, kimantawa kan abinci ko kuma mai shiryar da lafiyar abinci ba. Farashin girke-girke na dogara da abubuwan da ake ciki, zafin jiki, lokaci da kuma fasahar da ba a haɗa su ba.
